outline: This course aims to familiarize students with important critical approaches and theoretical frameworks in cultural studies. The course will introduce theoretical concepts in fields such as psychoanalysis, gender studies (including feminism and queer theories), and post-colonialism. By reading original theoretical texts and related essays, students will cultivate their ability to engage with theories to examine cultural products such as films, TV series, and anime.

Week 15: Horror and gender

Week 18: Oral presentations
